hero.headline: You are invited to the good half
hero.blurb: You have been spared the speeches and given the bar. This is not a downgrade, it is a favour.

sections.title: When to turn up
sections.body: From 7:30pm. Dinner will be finished; the dancing will not have started, because nobody ever starts the dancing. That is your job.

sections.title: A short list of things not to mention
items: Anything with the word 'roadmap' in it.

privateNotes: Draft — not sending until the evening numbers are confirmed with the venue in April.
